messages:
maria: Quick heads-up — ran a long-window benchmark comparing fp16 vs int8+KV on magnum-13b-v2 (private bring-up). KV-cache ON, rotary_scale default. Repro steps and logs below.

arjun: nice — what metric are you using to detect regression?

maria: token-by-token perplexity and a simple QA accuracy on our 12k-token evaluation story. Noticed divergence starting ~8200 tokens; fp16 remains coherent, int8+KV drifts and hallucinates by ~9100.

sasha: can you paste the minimal repro run command?

maria: sure — run order we used:
```bash
./bench/run_longctx_eval.sh --model magnum-13b-v2 --quant int8 --kv-cache on --max-tokens 12000 
# baseline fp16: change --quant fp16 and rerun
```
Logs excerpt:
```
[2026-03-18 13:02:10] seed=42 max_tokens=12000 quant=int8 kv=on rotary_scale=1.0
... token=8199 context_tok_id=... perplexity_delta=0.02
... token=9121 NEXT_TOKEN_CONFIDENCE DROP -> 0.02; generation: "the president of the purple islands"
```

tony: huh — rotary_scale 1.0? have you tried the RoPE rescale factor patch we landed last week? could be underflow/artifact when quant+kv combine.

maria: I tried rotary_scale=0.9 quickly, divergence pushed to ~9400 but still happens. Attached diffs show the attention score percentile compression when int8 kernels hit cache boundary.

kelsey: did you run with shard-join turned on? the earlier bugs were sometimes cross-shard misalignment.

maria: shard-join OFF for these runs to isolate single-shard behavior. Also repeated with and without prefill streaming; same pattern.

arjun: CI runs? link?

ci-bot: Bench job queued: https://ci.internal/bench/1747770001. Results (summary): int8+KV median latency 1.8x lower, token cost 0.6x, but QA F1 drops 12% after 9k tokens.

sasha: can you throw a trace of the KV index at the failure window? i.e., dump k/v indices around 8k-10k tokens.

maria: pasted KV dump snippet below (sanitized):
```
# KV index snapshot @ token 9050
kv_idx: [ ... 9008:slot=4123,rot_off=16,valid=1,seq=9008, ... 9012:slot=4125,rot_off=0,valid=0,seq=0, ... ]
# noticed several slot collisions where rot_off resets to 0 near boundary
```

tony: slot reset to 0 sounds like wraparound — maybe our index masking doesn't account for quantized stride padding. Could be prefetch + memcpy rounding.

kelsey: would be useful to run the same config with our consistency checker (kv-checker) and with deterministic memcpy (NO_ASYNC_COPY). If that removes it, it's an infra memcpy ordering bug.

maria: scheduled two runs: (1) kv-checker + deterministic copy, (2) int8 fallback to int4-grid (to see lower precision effect). Will post logs.

arjun: also add rotary scaling sweep [0.8,0.9,1.0,1.1] and run with both per-token and per-sequence KV eviction strategies — that might highlight interaction space faster.

maria: good call — adding that to the grid. Quick note: when I re-ran with kv-checker ON, mismatch rates drop ~10x but a small divergence still appears at ~11k tokens (so not purely racey).

sasha: interesting — that suggests a numerical rounding accumulation maybe amplified by RoPE at extreme distances. Could try a synthetic test with constant repeated context to see if error accumulates predictably.

maria: yep drafting a synthetic: repeated 512-token anchor X 20, then probe question. If that reproduces, we can bisect the layer where attention weights first diverge.

kelsey: please tag me when you have the CI job links. I'll try a cross-compile with the new int8 kernel that preserves higher mantissa bits.

maria: will do. Thanks all :thumbsup:

ci-bot: Added tracking ticket infra/eng-ml #7834 for action items (kv dump artifacts, rotary sweep grid, kernel test)
